### Choices, Choices
Author: Doug Fields
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/choices-choices-homeword-march-6.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 6:12
Points:
- Believers have freedom in Christ, but not every permissible pursuit is beneficial.
- Good activities and ministry demands can subtly crowd out vital relational commitments like marriage.
- An unrelenting lifestyle of busyness carries painful spiritual and personal consequences.
- Believers must deliberately align their daily choices and schedules around what matters most.

### Using Your Freedom for God's Glory
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-jan-31-2011-11644829.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 6:12
Points:
- Liberation from legalism under grace does not give believers a license to live however they please.
- Freedom in Christ calls believers to a higher standard of purposeful discipleship.
- The way believers handle their personal liberties reveals where their true loyalties lie.
- God grants abundant freedom with the expectation that believers use it for His glory.
